display.entryTitle: Popcorn Machine Mickey and Minnie Pair

description: In the upper left of the popcorn machine, two sculpted kernels face each other: a Mickey and a Minnie, complete with her bow.

whereToLook.scene: The popcorn machine to the right of the register, upper left corner
whereToLook.exactSpot: Two popcorn pieces facing each other. One has a bow.

bestTip: Check the top left before the rest of the machine distracts you.
